name: kilo-code-kb-patch
description: Patches Kilo Code keyboard behavior: Enter for newline, Cmd+Enter to send, Cmd+Up/Down to recall earlier messages, smarter permission prompt key routing.

kiloCodeKbPatch.addAttachFileButton.markdownDescription: Add a `+` button to the Kilo Code prompt toolbar that opens the file picker directly. Reload the window after changing.

kiloCodeKbPatch.renameOpenInTab.markdownDescription: Retitle Kilo Code's editor-title "Open in Tab" action to "Kilo Code: Open" so its icon groups next to other AI "Open" icons in the editor title bar. Reload the window after changing.
